feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: A flash flood killed a 102-year-old woman in Spain and the same storm went on to kill in Catalonia
entry.summary: A storm system that drowned a 102-year-old woman in her home in Albacete on 3 October moved into Catalonia, where a wall collapse killed a man in Tordera and a second death was confirmed in Montornès del Vallès. — Sources: Euronews, 4 October 2026 · Cyprus Mail, 4 October 2026 · AEMET

entry.title: Vista, California tied its all-time heat record as the state's heat wave entered a sixth day
entry.summary: Vista, in San Diego County, reached 108 degrees Fahrenheit on 3 October, tying the city's all-time high last set in 1985 and beating the prior daily record by four degrees. — Sources: Watchers.news, 3 October 2026 · KTLA, 4 October 2026

entry.title: Heat and drought cost European Union farmers an estimated $3.6 billion in lost grain this year
entry.summary: The bloc's 2026 grain production fell an estimated 16 million tonnes, roughly the combined output of Italy, Belgium and the Netherlands. — Sources: The National, 2 October 2026 · Energy and Climate Intelligence Unit

entry.title: Indonesia's wildfire haze crisis is now expected to last into 2027
entry.summary: Forecasters have pushed back the monsoon rains that would clear the smoke from October to November, extending a crisis that has closed schools and driven respiratory complaints across Malaysia and Singapore since early August. — Sources: National Environment Agency, Singapore, 4 October 2026 · Malay Mail, 3 October 2026

entry.title: A global survey finds extreme heat is harming pregnant women and newborns
entry.summary: Wellcome surveyed 1,001 maternal-health professionals in Australia, Brazil, India, the United Kingdom and Zimbabwe: 98% had treated a pregnant woman harmed by extreme heat and 99% had treated an affected fetus or newborn. — Sources: Wellcome, via IPS News, 5 October 2026

entry.title: Chicago's Cook County had its worst heat-death toll in a decade
entry.summary: Cook County, Illinois recorded 16 heat deaths this summer, more than double its prior record of eight. — Sources: Chicago Sun-Times, 3 October 2026

entry.title: The European Commission's workplace heat rules are now targeted for December 2026
entry.summary: A Council of the European Union document confirms officials are telling member states the Quality Jobs Act proposal, which updates workplace safety rules to include heat exposure, is targeted for December 2026 specifically. — Sources: Council of the European Union, document 13885/26, 2 October 2026
